sum.what: Build a flat 32-bit array, then scan it 8 times.

push.what: Push N records while keeping links/indices to every 64th one.

strlist.what: Split a text into N words, store them, scan 4 times.

records.what: Build a log of N variant records, aggregate 4 times.

tree.what: Build a complete binary tree of depth D, sum it 8 times.

interp.what: Build an expression tree of depth D, evaluate it 8 times.

graph.what: Build CSR adjacency for V vertices / 8V edges, BFS from 4 sources.

words.what: Count word frequencies over a text of N words.

particles.what: Integrate N particles for 200 steps of exact binary32 vector math.

sexp.what: Generate N s-expression forms, parse into a tree, walk 4 times.

lru.what: LRU cache of capacity N/8 under N skewed lookups & invalidations.

scene.what: Build a depth-D scene graph, animate & update transforms for 16 frames.

calc.what: Generate, parse and evaluate N arithmetic expressions (1/3 malformed).

bintrees.what: Benchmarks Game binary-trees: build, check & discard trees up to depth D.

respond.what: Build & render N JSON responses with FNV-1a checksum.

blur.what: 16 passes of a 3x3 blur over a WxW 8-bit image.
